verdict.rationale: Kling documents text-to-video generation, and its agent workflow claims you can refine and edit videos over multiple rounds while preserving context. However, the iteration mechanics for video are described only in marketing-level terms. The documented mask-based local re-editing applies to Image 3.0 Omni, not video. Missing for 10: concrete documentation of video-specific iteration (e.g., extending or editing a generated clip, re-prompting from a prior result), independent or hands-on corroboration of the refine loop.

support.subject: As a creator, I can turn a text prompt into a video clip and iterate on the result without starting from scratch each time

citations.quote: Kling AI specializes in text-to-video, image-to-video, and text-to-image generation using diffusion transformer (DiT) architecture.
